subject.title: xurl skill: add confirm-before-post enforcement and audit log instructions

question: Should xurl be hardened as a bundled OpenClaw skill now, or should its write-action confirmation and audit contract move with xurl to a ClawHub/external package?
rationale: The request affects public/account-affecting writes and audit privacy, while current repository direction is slimming optional skills out of core and the related trim PR is still open.

options.title: Approve The Xurl Safety Contract First
options.body: Keep this open until maintainers decide the confirm-before-write scope, audit path/retention/redaction, and whether the policy lives in core or in a ClawHub-owned xurl package.

options.title: Resolve By Externalizing Xurl
options.body: If xurl should leave core, land a safe externalization path and close this only after the external package carries the accepted safety policy.

options.title: Accept SKILL.md-Only Guidance
options.body: Add instruction text only, accepting that it improves model guidance but does not create a hard write-enforcement boundary.

recommendation.title: Approve The Xurl Safety Contract First
recommendation.body: Keep this open until maintainers decide the confirm-before-write scope, audit path/retention/redaction, and whether the policy lives in core or in a ClawHub-owned xurl package.

likelyOwner.reason: They are assigned to the active bundled-skill trimming decision surface and have recent adjacent skill/package ownership history.
